assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one original office scene style sample for Engineer Quest, a Chinese high-school beginner embedded engineering career exploration game. Primary request: create a charming editorial game illustration of a small independent electronics studio named only in external UI (NO text in image). Wide horizontal landscape, warm late afternoon light. At right a friendly young adult Chinese female hardware mentor with short dark hair, round glasses and moss-green work jacket with small orange enamel pin, holding a small unlabelled notebook and smiling naturally. At left and center a cozy wooden electronics workbench, retro cream monitor with blank pale screen, green cutting mat, small desk lamp, little component trays, potted plant, stools, soft window shadows, light paper notices. Painterly but crisp hand-drawn linework, warm paper grain, restrained isometric-ish perspective; sophisticated indie management/adventure game concept art, not childish kawaii, not photorealism. Colors: cream #f4eedf, deep forest #193c36, muted jade #7b9e8a, coral orange #df7155, honey #e4bb63. Composition: generous pale uncluttered negative space in the upper left; character on far right; desk occupies lower half; scene fits a wide 3:2 crop. Constraints: original character and environment, no logos, no lettering, no UI, no labels, no circuit diagram, no exact pin representations, no watermark. This image is atmosphere only; all functional wiring and technical labels will be rendered in HTML/SVG.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a wide original explorable-room background for Engineer Quest, a Chinese high-school beginner engineering adventure. Edit/reference image: the supplied original office scene establishes the same female mentor identity and warm hand-painted style. Recompose it into a full wide 16:9 game environment, slightly elevated three-quarter side view, eye-level enough to feel present, not a UI mockup. A small cozy electronics studio at blue hour with rich forest/teal shadows and warm amber desk lamps. Build three clear interaction areas with generous separation: LEFT at about 20% horizontal is a small wooden company mail station with one cream envelope sticking out and a corkboard of completely blank paper, CENTER at about 52% horizontal is the main wooden workbench with a green open loose-parts tray and a closed cream manual, RIGHT at about 80% horizontal is the same original young adult Chinese female mentor with short dark bob, round glasses, green work jacket and small orange square pin, standing beside her stool and holding her brown notebook. Keep her complete head and torso visible, friendly calm smile. Around them: tall dusk-blue window, shelves, plants, soft wiring tools, blank retro monitor, warm wooden floor, foreground work surface. Crisp editorial ink lines, subtle painted paper grain, sophisticated indie adventure game atmosphere, restrained details that stay readable at laptop scale. Wider room and more atmospheric depth than the source; no game HUD or overlay, no text, no lettering, no numerals, no symbols, no logos, no watermark. Do not draw readable technical labels, connected circuits, exact pin diagrams, sparks or combat equipment. No battle, no fantasy armor, no 3D photoreal rendering. This is only the room art; every hotspot, objective, Chinese word and actual circuit control will be HTML/SVG.
